question: Who among the following is the Chairman of the committee constituted to examine the provision of "One Nation One Election" in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ram Nath Kovind**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Government of India** officially constituted a high-level committee (HLC) on **September 2, 2023**, to evaluate the feasibility and mechanisms of implementing **"One Nation, One Election"**.
 
• The committee is headed by **Ram Nath Kovind**, who served as the **14th President of India** from **2017 to 2022**.
 
• The primary objective of this committee is to examine and make recommendations for holding simultaneous elections for the **Lok Sabha** (House of the People), **State Legislative Assemblies**, **Municipalities**, and **Panchayats**.
 
• The high-level committee consists of several distinguished members, including **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, former Leader of Opposition in the Rajya Sabha **Ghulam Nabi Azad**, former Finance Commission Chairman **N.K. Singh**, former Lok Sabha Secretary General **Subhash C. Kashyap**, senior advocate **Harish Salve**, and former Chief Vigilance Commissioner **Sanjay Kothari**.
